name: Condensed Milk
description: Condensed milk is a hyper-concentrated dairy matrix generated through the controlled vacuum evaporation of bovine milk, followed by the addition of high-purity sucrose. This functional food architecture creates a shelf-stable system that preserves critical dairy minerals (calcium, phosphorus) and high-quality milk proteins (casein, whey) within a dense, easily absorbable energy medium. While providing rapid glycemic substrates, it serves as a viable dense-calorie source for individuals requiring immediate metabolic fueling or those with specific nutritional deficits.
macroIntro: A high-density energy pool defined by a disaccharide-rich carbohydrate matrix, balanced by emulsified milk lipids and structural proteins.
microIntro: A refined concentrate of dairy-derived divalent cations and essential B-complex vitamins supporting neurological and skeletal integrity.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: Thermodynamic density primarily provided by the synergistic combustion of exogenous sucrose and lipid oxidation.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: Consists of high-bioavailability caseins and whey proteins containing the full spectrum of essential amino acids.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Native milk lipids providing essential saturated fatty acids and facilitating the absorption of lipophilic micronutrients.

macroNutrients.name: Total Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Hyper-concentrated carbohydrate matrix predominantly comprised of sucrose and lactose, resulting in rapid blood glucose kinetics.

microNutrients.name: Calcium
microNutrients.description: A high-availability divalent cation essential for hydroxyapatite-based skeletal mineralization and signal transduction.

microNutrients.name: Phosphorus
microNutrients.description: Synergistically coupled with calcium to maintain bone matrix density and facilitate high-energy phosphate bond synthesis (ATP).

microNutrients.name: Potassium
microNutrients.description: A major intracellular electrolyte maintaining fluid osmotic balance and neuromuscular contraction efficacy.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B12 (Cobalamin)
microNutrients.description: Crucial cofactor for myelination of nerve fibers and the synthesis of deoxyribonucleic acid.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin)
microNutrients.description: Essential coenzyme in the respiratory chain, facilitating electron transport during cellular energy production.

healthBenefits: Rapid Glycogen Resynthesis: The high concentration of simple sugars provides an immediate substrate for replenishing hepatic and muscular glycogen stores following strenuous exertion.
Skeletal Matrix Maintenance: The bioavailability of milk-derived calcium and phosphorus provides a direct stimulus for ongoing osteoblast activity.
Caloric Density for Anabolic Support: Acts as an efficient nutritional supplement for individuals exhibiting high metabolic rates or suboptimal body mass index requirements.
Hemopoietic and Neurological Support: Supplies natural cobalamin and riboflavin, which stabilize erythrocyte production and optimize neural impulse transmission.
precautionsIntro: Due to the extreme concentration of refined carbohydrates, regular consumption poses significant metabolic risks:
precautions: Insulinemic and Glycemic Dysregulation: The high sugar content induces rapid insulin spikes, making this contraindicated for individuals with type 2 diabetes or insulin sensitivity disorders.

Lactose-Intolerant Phenotypes: The concentration process retains high levels of lactose, which, in lactase-deficient individuals, precipitates osmotic gastrointestinal disturbances (bloating, dysbiosis).
Cariogenic Potential: The viscous, sugar-rich matrix promotes oral bacterial adhesion, significantly accelerating tooth enamel demineralization and dental caries.
